Image codec self-test fixture attribution

The self-test data compiled into Mori.exe includes the unmodified synthetic
HEIC alpha fixture from libheif:
  Project: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
  Commit: f223c23c5863cd9e7f29c48438c4da3b308a17aa
  File: tests/data/with-alpha-512x512.heic
  Git blob SHA-1: 897d470339a3f4ceeff5155e981bbefceea9f648
  Size: 8284 bytes

The corresponding upstream root COPYING is reproduced in
test-fixtures-COPYING.txt. Its library/sample distinction is retained;
no separate MIT or public-domain claim is made for the fixture.
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/f223c23c5863cd9e7f29c48438c4da3b308a17aa/COPYING

WebP and AVIF self-test fixtures are synthetic color blocks generated for
this project using the pinned Magick.NET 15.0.0 distribution. Other images
and PDFs used in tests are generated programmatically, not personal media.
